def greens(fr):
    out=[]
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='N':
            cs=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            rs=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]
            kid=[fr.segmentation['nodes'][c]['color'] for c in n['children']]
            c=kid[0] if kid else '?'
            out.append((min(cs),max(cs),min(rs),max(rs),c))
    return sorted(out)
res = action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':31,'col':31}])
print("after click player center:", greens(current_frame), "step", current_frame.step)
</parameter>

def greens(fr):
    out=[]
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='N':
            cs=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            rs=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]
            kid=[fr.segmentation['nodes'][c]['color'] for c in n['children']]
            c=kid[0] if kid else '?'
            out.append((min(cs),max(cs),min(rs),max(rs),c))
    return sorted(out)
